result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but several visual inconsistencies exist: truncated text in the horizontal 'Fastest near you' carousel, inconsistent favorite-button styling between cards, a washed-out first card thumbnail, and content clipped abruptly at the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') and its delivery text ('€1.90 delivery') is clipped at the screen edge with no ellipsis or fade indicator, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis inside the card, and add a peek/fade gradient at the right edge so it reads as a scrollable carousel.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/black circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, size and icon color across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is abruptly cut in half by the bottom navigation bar, with no visible title, rating or metadata, so the list appears to end unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the nav bar height (safe-area inset) so the last card can fully scroll into view above the tab bar.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail is very light/washed out compared to the dark, high-contrast images of neighboring cards, and the white '15–25 min' badge has poor contrast against it.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image overlay/gradient behind badges, or darken the badge background so the time label stays legible on light images.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is cut off at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the next chip without any scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Show a partial chip with a fade edge or scroll indicator so users know more filters exist horizontally.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell, heart/favorite buttons) have no visible text labels, and the bell's red dot conveys state by color alone.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels/aria-labels for icon buttons and pair the notification indicator with a count or text alternative.
